item.description: Scotland's Lost Shore Surf Resort was named the best surf park in the world, but the author who named it number one didn't surf every wave pool in the world.

item.title: An Olympic Surfer Gave Us His Thoughts on the Reported Qualification Changes for LA 2028
item.description: News broke last week of an overhaul coming to surfing’s Olympic qualification system. AOS Midia, a Brazilian surf outlet, received alleged details of the changes that would alter how surfers qualify for the sport’s third Olympic appearance at LA 2028. In summary, the new system would add more weight to the ISA World Surfing Games […]

item.title: Darren Handley Goes From Blank to Board, Creating a Custom Shape for Joel Vaughan
item.description: Getting a new surfboard is one of the best things there is, so Joel Vaughan let Darren Handley walk us through the process from blank to finished surfboard.

item.title: Kolohe Andino Escaped an Apartment Fire in Australia
item.description: Kolohe Andino, a 31-year-old American Championship Tour veteran, says he's OK after an apartment fire started where he was staying on Australia's Gold Coast.

item.title: Sleeper Shark Caught on Camera in Antarctic Waters for Possibly the First Time Ever
item.description: The sleeper shark isn't a creature we see often, and certainly not in the frigid waters off Antarctica. But lo and behold, there was one seen on camera.

item.description: Yet another announcement has come down the pipeline of a pool breaking ground – this time its an Endless Surf powered wave in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Can Surfing’s New Generation Handle Carissa Moore? The World Champ on Her Competitive Return
item.description: Carissa Moore has five world titles and a gold medal on her surfing resume. And a wealth of knowledge. Can the new generation handle this competitive force?

item.title: A Hiker Succumbed to Hypothermia in New York’s Adirondack Mountains
item.description: Tragedy struck in New York when a 21-year-old hiker slipped on the state's highest peak. Rescuers were unable to reach her before hypothermia took hold.
